decision: Authorize one additional T-001 attempt to correct the Linux-only case-variant assertion identified by the independent evaluator. prior_reason: Independent evaluator evidence for attempt 4 found the required Linux T-001 suite fails two assertions in test_literal_control_paths_are_never_observed_or_opened: the assertions expect non-cacheable-external-state for case-variant names on a case-sensitive filesystem, while accepted exact-path semantics report non-cacheable-policy. Correct the platform-sensitive test expectation without changing accepted behavior, rerun required Linux checks, and obtain fresh evaluator PASS before completion.
